question:
A school creates a temporary identification system for five students $A=\{S_1,S_2,S_3,S_4,S_5\}$. The available identification numbers form the set $B=\{101,102,103,104,105,106\}$. A function $f:A\to B$ assigns $f(S_1)=101$, $f(S_2)=103$, $f(S_3)=104$, $f(S_4)=105$ and $f(S_5)=106$. The mathematics class studies this assignment as a function and investigates whether different students receive different images and whether every element of the stated codomain is used. The codomain is exactly the set $B$ given above, even though one identification number may remain unassigned.

(a) Find the range of $f$.

(b) Determine whether $f$ is one-one and justify your answer.

(c) Determine whether $f$ is onto and identify any element of $B$ having no pre-image.

(d) If $f(S_5)$ is changed from $106$ to $104$, determine how the one-one and onto properties of the function change.
explanation:
(a)
The images of the five elements of $A$ are $101,103,104,105$ and $106$. Therefore, the range is $\{101,103,104,105,106\}$.

(b)
All five students have distinct images. Thus, if $f(S_i)=f(S_j)$, then the corresponding students must be the same. Hence, $f$ is one-one.

(c)
The codomain is $B=\{101,102,103,104,105,106\}$, whereas the range is $\{101,103,104,105,106\}$. The element $102$ has no pre-image. Since the range is not equal to the codomain, $f$ is not onto.

(d)
After changing $f(S_5)$ to $104$, both $S_3$ and $S_5$ have the same image $104$. Therefore, the function is no longer one-one. Its range becomes $\{101,103,104,105\}$, so both $102$ and $106$ have no pre-images. Hence, the modified function is neither one-one nor onto.

options.A: The range is $\{101,102,103,104,105,106\}$; $f$ is one-one and onto. After the change, it remains one-one but is not onto.
options.B: The range is $\{101,103,104,105,106\}$; $f$ is onto but not one-one, and $102$ has no pre-image. After the change, it becomes one-one and onto.
options.C: The range is $\{101,103,104,105\}$; $f$ is neither one-one nor onto, and $106$ has no pre-image. After the change, it becomes onto but not one-one.
options.D: The range is $\{101,103,104,105,106\}$; $f$ is one-one but not onto, and $102$ has no pre-image. After the change, the function is neither one-one nor onto, with $102$ and $106$ having no pre-images.
